releases.notes: K-line + CAN bridge firmware 381, and the first dash screen firmware. The SD card now logs every CAN frame and every K-line exchange whenever a card is in, and deletes its oldest logs when the card fills. The screen build drives a Waveshare touchscreen on the XIAO's USB-C: gauges, a graph, the SD log with New log and Mark, and DME read presets. New and not yet run on a screen in the car: keep build 10 on a board you rely on. Update keeps your settings.

K-line + CAN bridge firmware 379. A reversed-strip switch for a shift light mounted end for end (Shift Light app 1.12). The log stream for the R53 Logger now goes out every 10 ms, one packet per 100 Hz row. ECU program write and recovery through the board for the R53 Logger, with retries that finish a download a lost reply left open. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Reversed strip: a switch in the Shift Light app (1.12) for a strip mounted end for end, so the bar fills from the other end. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.

Log stream for the R53 Logger: the board sends its CAN frames as one compressed stream, and the K-line + CAN board adds its K-line replies and the wideband at 100 Hz. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.

The board finds its car on the bus at power-on. Moved to a different car, it switches to the one it hears and keeps your LEDs, colours and switches. Boards on build 5 or newer can install this from the Shift Light app over Bluetooth. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
LED test at power-on, switched on from the Shift Light app (1.7). Boards on build 5 can install this from the app over Bluetooth. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Firmware updates over Bluetooth from the Shift Light app (1.6 or newer). This one needs USB; later ones can come from the app. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Brings back VTP/1 for data loggers, which build 3 dropped. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Protocol v3, the one firmware every car's board now runs. Update keeps your thresholds and colours. Needs Shift Light app 1.5 or the web app 2.0.

The R53 Shift Light K-line + CAN board (rev C, XIAO ESP32-S3) joins the flasher. C3 board: remote CAN frames never read as RPM, VTP loss counts only its own frames, Identify no longer pauses the board, and a new RPM id or scale drops the old reading.
Silent app handshake: changing settings needs Android app 1.2 or newer.
